recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No current FHIR core source edit is needed unless a future Security or FM decision changes the relationship between Contract signer roles and Signature.type purposes.
issue_request: FHIR-5658 is a Published/Persuasive Security change request for DSTU1 Contract asking to add ASTM E1762 section 8.2.2 definitions to the ASTM signature purpose vocabulary because short names alone were unclear.
initial_application: Git commit ee90e45c798d2fb961e7e28d3ff9a052c19e26b2 added ASTM definitions and copyright wording to the then-current Contract signer/signature-purpose value set; c455598a280e9b8e7988a17473bcc30bbfd0013d moved the work toward Signature, and 591b6b1e2af11332f5abed7455a91d11b91513b1 later created the standalone ASTM signature CodeSystem while preserving the definitions.
additional_context: Current Contract.signer.type is a signer-role binding and the Contract signer value set explicitly says it is related but different to signature type. The current build actively includes source/datatypes/codesystem-astm-signature-type.xml, and the Signature Type value set composes the ASTM system. FHIR-9082 and FHIR-8918 are the same change family for display-name completion.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The active CodeSystem has all 18 ASTM signature purpose concepts with substantive definitions, and no Contract source edit is appropriate because Contract signer roles are no longer the ASTM signature-purpose vocabulary.
